_meta.note: Section per step, each with its own accessory, plus the Prism import screenshot. A regular player types nothing at all: step 3 has no button because nothing handles interactions, and it needs none. Mojang authenticates a join attempt before the whitelist is consulted, so the attempt itself is the proof and wly reads it off the log.
_meta.title: Card

components.content:
### 1. install prism launcher
any launcher will run the pack. only prism keeps it up to date for you.

### 2. import the instance
`Add Instance` → `Import from zip` → paste the link.

items.description: Prism Launcher's Add Instance window, Import from zip selected, with the link field outlined.

components.content:
### 3. just try to join
```
158.180.53.71
```
you will be turned away the first time, that is expected. wly sees the attempt and asks an admin to let you in, so there is nothing to fill in and nothing to send.

-# **worth knowing:** prism runs a small updater before each launch, which is what keeps your mods in sync. it ships inside the zip and we check it on the way in. if you would rather not, take the .mrpack from the pack page and update by hand.
